name: sii-style-teacher-pilot-membership-1gpu
description: Finite 1-GPU multiselect_pilot generation/readout check, with 2 chains and a 1024-token cap. The historical centered filename is retained for compatibility; this payload now explicitly selects candidate Yes/No membership, not centered label logits. Direct and verify views have distinct reasoning prompts and isolated caches. Both Yes/No tokens are resolved and validated with the tokenizer; readout retains full task context. Truncation is excluded with coverage reported, and missing/invalid probabilities fail closed. Writes runs/qz/sii_style_teacher_pilot_membership/<view>/q/membership/exclude/merged. Configuration only; real-model validation remains pending and no job is submitted by the harness author.
command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
TEACHER_VIEW=${TEACHER_VIEW:-direct}
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
cd "$R"
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz"
status=0
REASONING=1 READOUT=1 SHARDS=1 SAMPLES=2 MAX_TOKENS=1024 MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 MAX_NUM_SEQS=128 GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.9 REASONING_BATCH=32 READOUT_BATCH=4 READOUT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=8192 MAX_PHASE_SECONDS=21600 Q_TRANSFORM=membership TRUNCATED_POLICY=exclude TEACHER_ID="Qwen3.5-4B:${TEACHER_VIEW}" TEACHER_VIEW="$TEACHER_VIEW" MODEL="$R/models/Qwen3.5-4B" DATA_DIR="$R/data/multiselect_pilot" RUN_ROOT="$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher_pilot_membership" LOG_DIR="$R/logs/qz" bash harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh > "$R/logs/qz/sii_style_teacher_pilot_membership_${TEACHER_VIEW}.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
printf 'JOB EXIT=%s\n' "$status"
exit "$status"
